newsitem.title: ITALY: No basis to Italian Sai sale talk-Premafin.
newsitem.headline: No basis to Italian Sai sale talk-Premafin.

text.p: Italian group Premafin Finanziaria said there was no basis for speculation about a possible sale of Societa' Assicuratrice Industriale (Sai) reported in Italian newspapers recently.
Turin-based Sai, which is Italy's largest motor insurer, is controlled by Premafin, the holding group of Ligresti, and French group GAN.
Sai has been put in the spotlight on the Milan stock market as a takeover candidate and its shares rose 0.85 percent to 13,835 lire on Friday.
A statement from Premafin called the idea of a sale of Sai "without any foundation."
"No negotiations have been started with anyone for the sale of the stake," it added.

Sai's chairman Salvatore Ligresti and managing director Fausto Rapisarda resigned from the group this week and the company said it will announce a new chairman and also a new managing director within the next 10 days.
